parameters.question: The analysis was conducted on a dataset containing 1,901 cells and 36,601 genes, presumably related to non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) as suggested by the file path. These clusters should guide the selection of marker genes, with a focus on those that can distinguish between these major cell populations. yes emphasise certain cell types

CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4 and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while IL2 and IFNG are functional markers for T helper cells. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while GZMB and PRF1 are functional markers for cytotoxic T cells. CD4 and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD4+ T cells and B cells.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3, CD4, and CD25 are canonical markers for regulatory T cells, while CTLA4 is a functional marker. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD79A, and MS4A1 are canonical markers for B cells, while IGHD is a functional marker. CD3E and CD8A are negative markers to exclude T cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138 and XBP1 are canonical markers for plasma cells, while IGHG1 and IGHA1 are functional markers. CD19 and CD3E are negative markers to exclude B cells and T cells.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1 and NKG7 are canonical markers for NK cells, while KLRD1 and GZMB are functional markers. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD68, CD14, and CD163 are canonical markers for monocytes/macrophages, while CSF1R is a functional marker. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C and CD209 are canonical markers for dendritic cells, while HLA-DRA and CCR7 are functional markers. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1 and CDH5 are canonical markers for endothelial cells, while VEGFA and KDR are functional markers. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, and FAP are canonical markers for fibroblasts, while PDGFRB is a functional marker. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, and ACTA2 are canonical markers for pericytes, while NOTCH3 is a functional marker. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for mast cells, while CPA3 and FCER1A are functional markers. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.
